description: Leading oilseed crop in India rich in 40% protein and 20% edible oil. Majorly cultivated in rainfed black soils of central India.
High-value legume oilseed providing ~45% edible oil and 26% protein. Grown in sandy loam to light red soils.
Premier winter oilseed crop of Northern and Western India yielding ~38-42% pungent edible cooking oil.
Heart-friendly oilseed with high polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFA) and vitamin E, grown predominantly in Southern peninsula.
Ancient oilseed known as Queen of Oilseeds with ~48-50% high antioxidant oil content (sesamol and sesamolin).
Drought-tolerant winter oilseed with rich linoleic acid content (78%), widely grown in drylands of Deccan plateau.
Crucial non-edible commercial oilseed where India dominates 85% of world production, essential for lubricants, polymers, and green chemistry.
Tribal hill oilseed crop cultivated in poor marginal soils, delivering clear, quick-drying edible oil.
